request.query: LiouvilleWith exponent cutoff upper bound and rational affine invariance

items.name: LiouvilleWith.rat_mul
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {r : ℚ}, LiouvilleWith p x → r ≠ 0 → LiouvilleWith p (↑r * x)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.mono
items.type: ∀ {p q x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → q ≤ p → LiouvilleWith q x

items.name: LiouvilleWith.mul_rat
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ} {r : ℚ}, LiouvilleWith p x → r ≠ 0 → LiouvilleWith p (x * ↑r)

items.name: LiouvilleWith.exists_pos
items.type:
∀ {p x : ℝ},
  LiouvilleWith p x →
    ∃ C, ∃ (_ : 0 < C), ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ n ∧ ∃ m, x ≠ ↑m / ↑n ∧ |x - ↑m / ↑n| < C / ↑n ^ p
